from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A single financial metric value extracted from one report."""
    company: Literal["AquaBounty Technologies Inc."] = Field(description="The company name as specified in the task")
    metric_name: Literal["Other Current Liabilities"] = Field(description="The specific line item queried in the task")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the reported value corresponds to")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The reported amount as a string to preserve formatting")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Collection of all extracted financial metric records."""
    metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
